Costume: School Uniform (Summer)
Satono walks in

Ah, *sniff*...! I-I'm okay...
*hic*... Excuse me...!
I know... What if we had flowers here...?
...? Is that how it works...?

Flowers gently comfort any heart.
So I'm certain they will bring solace!

Trainer, I hereby appoint you as the
"Sub-Leader" of the Campus Floral Initiative—!

Yay! Let's make the entire academy
absolutely gorgeous so everyone can enjoy it!

First, we can hang colorful flower baskets...
and build a biotope in the courtyard... Ah, the possibilities are endless!

To make this a success, I need a calm and attentive sub-leader...
In other words—Trainer! I need you!

Oh, you weren't aware?
Well, the Campus Floral Initiative is...
Agreed~! I think that's a wonderful idea~!

So that's it. Dia-san, you're really straightforward... or should I say, bold!
Usually people hesitate when asking adults for help~!

Oh, really?
I merely based it on the Western gardens owned by the Satono family, but...

Satono Diamond murmured in wonder.
Ever sincere and innocent, the concept didn't seem to click with her.

Some time after becoming Satono Diamond's trainer.
It happened all of a sudden—

Now that you mention it, we don't have enough hands.
Hmm... Is there another good idea...?

That is why I devoted myself purely to "what is needed right now."
Even if it was not to their liking, still...

Yeah, totally! That's Dia-san for you!
To put all this together so thoroughly all by yourself...!

No, it wasn't just my doing—
it was all thanks to Trainer helping me out!

Girls who are troubled often come here.
To sort out their feelings in private...

Right?! If I do say so myself, it's brilliant.
...Hehe, this kind of feels like back then.

Sub-Leader, what do you think?!
About placing a planter here!

Sub-Leader! Let's prepare the meeting materials right away!
If we combine our efforts, we can definitely create something wonderful!
Yes... Back when my parents and McQueen-san acknowledged you—

They helped me in the library until late yesterday.
Selecting the materials and compiling everything so swiftly and accurately...!

To bring joy to everyone...!
Thanks to you, I've realized what is truly important once again.

—Just as the name says, it's an annual school service activity
where volunteers gather to plant and arrange flowers on campus!

I was chosen as the leader this year♪
It's a big responsibility!

And so, we worked right up until dorm curfew to finish the proposal.
The next day—

The most important thing for the two of us... is making our dream come true.
Not today's trial.

Just like back then... "what is needed right now"
for this volunteer work isn't extravagance, but...
...She left...

Looking around, there are so many places lacking flowers...
Shall we take a look inside the school building next...!

—That concludes our proposal for this year's new initiatives!
What does everyone think...?
Ah! My apologies, someone was already here—!
